digests.thesis: Argus is technically sound (tests pass, context chains type-safely, prompts are sharp) but leaks value in the SEAMS between domains — the gap between what the code SAYS and what PRODUCTION does. The repeated structural pattern is collect-correctly, display-correctly, never-feed-back. Domain audits validate each half in isolation and miss that nobody owns the wire between them. The forward direction must therefore prioritize a Product-validation track (does anyone return?) over polish, instrument the existing telemetry so the team can see if it's winning, fix the silent-failure foundations (quota loss, dead-event dashboard), and add reality-checks so confident-but-wrong outputs are caught. A roadmap that fixes every domain finding and skips PV1/PV2 ships a beautifully-built tool no one returns to.

DISTRIBUTION SCISSORS (kills Verdict/Harbormaster as REPLACEMENTS): the differentiator 'Argus watches your execution; ChatGPT can't' requires an instrumentable runtime, but the non-dev strategist executes in a chat box / by hand — no hookable seam. CONCEPT MIS-SCOPING (caught by judges): concepts claim per-assumption work is '2 weeks' and that useAccuracyStore is the write-back channel — both wrong. STALE-CLAIM CORRECTION (don't inherit): concepts assert 'navigator.ts never acts' / 'learning loop is fully one-way' — judges verified this is OVERSTATED. buildNavigatorProfile (navigator.ts:~95) already consumes getSignals() into insights/coaching; retrospective.ts + context-builder.ts:buildEnhancedSystemPrompt already feed past-project learnings into live prompts; hit-rate.ts already closes a calibration loop for internal agent-selection. TRIGGER-RELIABILITY (kills Harbormaster's cinematic premise): verified that skills fire only on explicit /invocation or probabilistic host intent-routing — there is NO silent interception of execution-bound prompts, and v2's plugin manifest declares NO hooks array. A gate the user must voluntarily summon is not a gate; the execution-observation hook is net-new authoring, not 'already half-occupied.'

DECAY-BY-TIMER IS SPAM (kills Argus Live's push thesis): without a user-logged outcome or external world-signal, 'your assumption is 47 days old' is a timer dressed as insight — noise, not insight — and relocates the unvalidated-retention trap from pull to push. Per-assumption schema is necessary but NOT sufficient; needs a credible non-timer staleness source the architecture cannot currently produce.

COMMODITIZATION (kills Sharpening, ranked last 3.75): the entire single-move bet rests on Phase 1 decompose producing a sharper real_question than a naive 'critique my prompt' GPT-5/Claude call; a 10-second tool has nowhere to hide a weak output.
